title: Derived complete power-torsion modules have bounded torsion
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof reduces to a nonzerodivisor principal ideal and represents the module by a quotient of complete torsion-free modules. A Baire-category argument and an open-mapping theorem promote pointwise power torsion to one uniform annihilating power.
